name: Naibabiji Global Connect Hub
author: 奶爸建站笔记

sections.description:
Naibabiji Global Connect Hub is a powerful WordPress plugin that helps you easily manage and display various contact methods.

Features

  • Multiple contact methods: Phone, Mobile, Email, WhatsApp, WeChat, Telegram, Facebook, Instagram, X, LinkedIn, YouTube, Pinterest, TikTok, and more
  • Flexible frontend display: Supports list, inline, and icon layouts
  • Floating contact bar: Fixed on the right side of the page for easy visitor access
  • Drag-and-drop sorting: Easily adjust contact method order in the admin panel
  • Shortcode support: [naibabiji_connect]
  • Responsive design: Perfectly adapts to desktop and mobile devices
  • Hover popups: Phone number copying and QR code display
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/naibabiji-global-connect-hub directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress admin
  3. Go to ‘Settings > Connect Hub’ to configure contact methods
sections.faq:
How do I add contact methods?

In WordPress admin, go to ‘Settings > Connect Hub’ and click the ‘Add Contact Method’ button.

How do I use the shortcode?

Use the [naibabiji_connect] shortcode with various parameters, for example:
[naibabiji_connect layout=”icons” size=”lg”]

How do I enable the floating contact bar?

In the ‘Settings > Connect Hub > Settings’ tab, check ‘Enable Floating Contact Bar’.
